steps.title: Transcardial perfusion with PBS‑Heparin
steps.instruction: Perfuse the animal transcardially with 10 mL of ice‑cold PBS containing 10 U·mL⁻¹ Heparin at a flow rate of 4 mL·min⁻¹.

steps.title: Transcardial perfusion with PFA
steps.instruction: Perfuse the animal transcardially with 20 mL of ice‑cold 4 % (w/v) paraformaldehyde (PFA) at a flow rate of 6 mL·min⁻¹.

steps.title: Post‑fix dissected organs
steps.instruction: Place dissected organs in ~10 mL of 4 % (w/v) PFA in PBS per whole organ and incubate overnight at 4 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm).

steps.title: PBS‑NaN₃ washes (first)
steps.instruction: Wash the sample in PBS containing 0.05 % NaN₃ for 1 h, repeat three times at room temperature with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm).

steps.title: Accelerate fixation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 1 h at 37 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm) to accelerate fixation.

steps.title: Fix in 1 % formalin
steps.instruction: Fix the sample in 1 % formalin (FA) for 24 h at 4 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm).

substeps.instruction: During the wash, prepare 1 % FA solution by diluting saturated formalin (35–38 % v/v, e.g., 37 % formalin) 1:36 with HV wash buffer and keep the solution on ice.

steps.title: PBS‑NaN₃ washes (second)
steps.instruction: Wash the sample with 20 mL of PBS containing 0.05 % NaN₃ for 2 h, repeat three times at 37 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm). After each wash, clean or replace tubes to remove Triton X‑100 thoroughly. Store the delipidated sample in PBS + 0.05 % NaN₃ at 4 °C if needed.

steps.title: Incubate in 0.5× CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Immerse the fixed sample in 10 mL of 0.5× CUBIC‑L (1:1 dilution with water) in a 30 mL tube and incubate overnight at 37 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm).

steps.title: Delipidation with 1× CUBIC‑L
steps.instruction: Replace the solution with 10–15 mL of 1× CUBIC‑L in the 30 mL tube and delipidate for 72–120 h (3–5 days) at 37 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm). Replace CUBIC‑L every 48–72 h if the treatment exceeds 72 h.

steps.title: PBS‑5 % MeOH overnight
steps.instruction: Immerse the delipidated sample in 10 mL of PBS containing 5 % methanol in a 15 mL standing tube and incubate overnight at 37 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm).

steps.title: HV wash buffer washes (first set)
steps.instruction: Replace with fresh HV wash buffer and wash the sample two additional times for 2 h each.

steps.title: HV wash buffer washes (cold)
steps.instruction: Replace the HV wash buffer with fresh buffer and wash the sample at 4 °C under light shielding, shaking at 40–50 rpm for 2 h.

steps.title: Pre‑cool HV wash buffer
steps.instruction: One hour before staining, prepare HV wash buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 10 % w/v Triton X‑100, 500 mM NaCl) and cool it on ice.

steps.title: Exchange to HV staining buffer
steps.instruction: Exchange the sample into 10 mL of HV staining buffer (same composition plus 0.5 % w/v casein) containing the appropriate HV‑Additive for the primary antibody; incubate 1 h 30 min at 37 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm).

steps.title: Prepare antibody mix
steps.instruction: Calculate volumes X (primary Ab) and Y (secondary Fab) and Z (nuclear stain). Mix 50 µL 2× HV staining buffer, X µL primary Ab, Y µL secondary Fab, Z µL nuclear stain (BOBO‑1 4 µL, SYTOX Green 1.6 µL, or RedDot2 4 µL per whole mouse brain), and add distilled water to reach 100 µL total. Transfer the mix to a 500 µL LoBind tube and incubate 1 h 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Load sample into staining pot
steps.instruction: Collect the sample with a metal spoon, place it into the staining pot, and attach gently to a soft paper towel to absorb residual buffer.

steps.title: Transfer staining solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire 3D staining solution into a CUBICStars 3D tissue staining pot (CSSR005). After use, wash the pot with neutral detergent and distilled water.

steps.title: Add HV‑LLPS reagent
steps.instruction: Slowly pour HV‑LLPS reagent into the staining pot until the pot is filled, then remove any bubbles. HV‑LLPS prevents drying by covering the sample and staining solution.

steps.title: Stabilize Fab signals
steps.instruction: Incubate the staining chamber for 24 h at 4 °C with slow rotation (< 1 rpm) under light‑shielded conditions.

steps.title: Long‑term incubation
steps.instruction: Close the lid tightly and incubate the chamber for at least 168 h (1 week) at room temperature with slow rotation (< 1 rpm) under light‑shielded conditions.

steps.title: Remove HV‑LLPS and buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the residual buffer and HV‑LLPS reagent as described previously.

steps.title: Recover sample from pot
steps.instruction: Recover the sample from the staining pot with a metal spoon and discard the staining solution and HV‑LLPS reagent.

steps.title: Incubate in 0.5× CUBIC‑R+
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample in 15 mL of 0.5× CUBIC‑R+ (1:1 diluted with distilled water) in a 30 mL tube for 24 h at > 25 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm) under light‑shielded conditions.

steps.title: Incubate in 1× CUBIC‑R+
steps.instruction: Remove residual diluted CUBIC‑R+ and incubate the sample in 15 mL (or 30 mL if embedding in agarose) of 1× CUBIC‑R+ for 48 h at > 25 °C with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm) under light‑shielded conditions. Ensure temperature stays ≥ 25 °C; CUBIC‑R+ may crystallize in colder conditions.

steps.title: Final PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sample in 30 mL of PBS in a 50 mL tube for 2 h at room temperature with gentle shaking (40–50 rpm) under light‑shielded conditions.

steps.title: Microscopy preparation
steps.instruction: Use the cleared sample for microscopic observation; embed in 2 % agarose if gel embedding is required.
